newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dana says 68.89% acceptances for open offer.
newsitem.headline: Dana says 68.89% acceptances for open offer.

text.p: Irish exploration group Dana Petroleum said on Monday that it had received valid acceptances for 68.89 percent of the total shares made available in a placing and open offer.

Dana said in a statement that valid acceptances had been received in respect 83,687,057 new ordinary shares with the balance, 56,090,723 shares, to be taken up by institutional investors with whom they were conditionally placed.
The placing and open offer was jointly underwritten by Guinness Mahon & Co. Ltd and UBS Ltd.
Dana on March 26, announced that it was issuing 139.78 million shares at 21.5 pence each to raise about 30 million stg, before expenses.
The funds would be used to acquire 40 percent in Yogan-neft, 20 percent in Yuganskoil and five percent in Evikhon.
Dana Petroleum would pay a total consideration of 8.4 million stg in cash and 21 million new shares for the stakes in the Russian companies.
The balance would be used to develop oil fields at South Vat-Yoganskoye and Sortymskoye, also in Russia.
